rules.condition: a write and a read occur at the same clock edge and the flags allow both
rules.statement: Simultaneous write and read are independent and both are accepted at the same clock edge when o_full and o_empty allow.
The FIFO accepts one word per write-clock cycle and delivers one word per read-clock cycle (REQ-PERF-001).

rules.condition: after a write into an empty FIFO
rules.statement: o_empty falls at the first read edge strictly after the write edge when PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 0, and one read period later when PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1.
The first read accepted after the write edge occurs after 2 cycles with PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 0 and after 3 cycles with PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1.

rules.condition: after a read from a full FIFO
rules.statement: o_full falls at the first write edge strictly after the read edge when PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 0, and one write edge later when PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1.
o_empty = 1 in the next cycle after the last word is read, for both PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME values.

rules.condition: the last free place is written
rules.statement: o_full = 1 in the next cycle after the last free place is written, for both PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME values.
Streaming has no gaps beyond the initial latency.

rules.condition: depth at least 4 + 2 x PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME, over the tested clock ratios
rules.statement: The side that is not rate-limited never stalls (REQ-PERF-002).

rules.condition: depth is smaller than needed for gap-free streaming
rules.statement: The FIFO remains functionally correct, although a gap may appear.
The memory is read at the address of the next read pointer.

rules.condition: read and write of the same address at the same edge
rules.statement: A read of the address written at the same edge returns the old word, and the read side takes a word only after the flag fell.
The memory must not be invalid at an address that is read.
Occupancy occ(a,b) = a - b if a is not below b, otherwise a + 2 x DEPTH - b.

Write-domain flops load at the edge from next values: a write is accepted when i_wr_en, not block and not full flop; the full flop is set when next occupancy equals DEPTH; the full-threshold flop when it reaches i_full_thr.
o_full = block OR full flop; o_full_thr = (i_full_thr equals 0) when block, otherwise the full-threshold flop.
o_overflow is a flop set one cycle after i_wr_en with not block and full flop.

Read-domain flops load at the edge from next values: a read is accepted when i_rd_en, not block and not empty flop; the empty flop is set when next occupancy equals 0; the threshold flop when at or below i_empty_thr.
o_empty = block OR empty flop; o_empty_thr = 1 when block, otherwise the empty-threshold flop.
o_underflow is a flop set one cycle after i_rd_en with not block and empty flop.
The memory read address is the next read pointer modulo DEPTH.
The write view of occupancy never underestimates the real occupancy and the read view never overestimates it.
o_full_thr is 0 until the first clock edge after release, then follows the formula even if i_full_thr is 0.
From that cycle writes are blocked and o_full is 1.
The write FSM leaves RUN, o_sw_rst_busy rises in the next cycle, and the request flop is raised.
The read FSM blocks reads (o_empty = 1), resets the read pointer in state RST for one cycle and raises the acknowledge.
The write FSM resets the write pointer in state PTR for one cycle and waits in HOLD until i_rst_n_sw is 1.
In REL the request is dropped; the read side leaves ACK when it sees the request at 0 and the write pointer at 0.
The write side leaves REL when it sees the acknowledge at 0 and the read pointer at 0, returns to RUN, and o_sw_rst_busy falls.
The FIFO is ready for writes when o_sw_rst_busy is 0 and i_rst_n_sw is 1.
A one-cycle low pulse on i_rst_n_sw starts the complete software reset sequence.
A hardware reset clears all FSMs.
The new low level is served after the write FSM is back in RUN.
